newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land gets two seats on Parkway board.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land gets two seats on Parkway board.

text.p: Singapore property blue chip DBS Land will soon acquire two seats on the board of healthcare group Parkway Holdings Ltd, the deputy chairman of DBS Land said.
"The answer is two," Han Cheng Fong said when asked at an investor briefing on Saturday on DBS Land's plans regarding Parkway. "We've just been invited to the board."
Han declined to comment further on discussions DBS Land is holding on Parkway with the controlling Tan family, the largest shareholder in the firm with its 24 percent.
DBS Land had bought 19.2 percent of Parkway for Singapore $391 million, making it the second biggest shareholder in the company.
"I leave it to you to guess," Han said on DBS Land's next move on the matter.
Under Singapore takeover rules, a general offer would be triggered if DBS Land secured 25 percent of Parkway.
